label: Gandalf
description: Grand, twinkling, and never late, whatever the clock says.
direction: Speak deep, warm and measured, like an ancient wizard: grave authority with a twinkle of mischief, rolling the words. Keep the direction word clear and unhurried.
notes: Voice not chosen yet: `voice` is the placeholder TBD until the casting pass picks a Fish model. The film register of Gandalf. His best-known lines are echoed in a few words each, bent toward the road, never quoted at length. Catchphrases sit on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.source_work: The Hobbit and The Lord of the Rings
rights.author: J.R.R. Tolkien; the film adaptations this register comes from are New Line Cinema / Warner Bros.
rights.pd_basis: None in the United States or United Kingdom. The Hobbit was published in 1937 and remains in US copyright until the end of 2032; Tolkien died in 1973. The voice cloned is the film performance of Ian McKellen, who is living, and the names are trademarks of Middle-earth Enterprises.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Ian McKellen's.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and is presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. A wizard arrives precisely when he means to.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Patience, my dear fellow.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Do try to keep up.
lines.start_drive_1: I am looking for someone to share in an adventure. You will do.
lines.start_drive_2: A wizard is never late. Let us keep it that way.
lines.start_drive_3: Onward, Shadowfax! Show us the meaning of haste. Within the limit.
lines.start_drive_4: The road goes ever on. Let us begin.
lines.start_drive_5: Fly, you fools! Or rather, drive. Carefully.
lines.start_drive_6: All we have to decide is which way to go. Fortunately, I know.
lines.start_drive_7: Good morning! Whether you wish it or not, we are off.
lines.start_drive_8: Keep your wits about you, and your hands on the wheel.
lines.start_drive_9: There is more to this driver than meets the eye. Proceed.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. I have no memory of this place.
lines.arrived: We have arrived, precisely when we meant to.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Follow your nose.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Fool of a Took!
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Even the very wise cannot see all exits.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. You shall not pass. Not for a while, at least.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Fool of a Took.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Tread carefully. This road has grown dangerous.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. A great eye, lidless and watching. Slow down.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. You shall not pass!
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Keep it secret. Keep it safe. Keep to the limit.
lines.reroute_chime: We have missed the turn. No matter. There is always another way.
